q: How do you compute month-over-month growth?
a: Aggregate per month, then (x − LAG(x) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(x) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) × 100. The first month is NULL.

q: LAG gives the previous row. Is that the previous day?
a: Not if days are missing. Check that the date gap equals 1, self-join on date − 1 day, or build a date spine first.

q: How do you compute days between consecutive orders per customer?
a: order_date − LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date), using the dialect's date difference (DATEDIFF, julianday, date subtraction).
Flag a new session when the gap from LAG(event_time) exceeds a threshold (e.g. 30 min), then a running SUM of the flag per user numbers the sessions.
